titulo.estudio: Un itinéraire modifié : Observer les formes
titulo.alumno: A changed journey: Vocabulary and forms

intro: Understand a change of transport and find the practical consequence for the trip. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

piezas.titulo: Reading the vocabulary and the forms
texto: Understand a change of transport and find the practical consequence for the trip. Match the subject with the request and check the dates, conditions and actions the message asks you to carry out.
Watch out: « À cause de » introduces the cause; « donc » and « en revanche » link its consequences. In this passage, «correspondance» means «connection».

frases.estudio: La correspondance de 14 h 10 est donc impossible; un autre train part à 15 h.
frases.alumno: So you will not be able to catch the 14:10 connection; another train leaves at 15 o'clock.

frases.estudio: Les voyageurs doivent consulter les écrans avant de rejoindre le quai.
frases.alumno: Passengers must check the screens before heading to the platform.
